name: @snowtree/desktop
description: Snowtree desktop application - Electron main process

scripts.build: rimraf dist && tsc && npm run copy:assets
scripts.copy:assets: mkdirp dist/infrastructure/database/migrations dist/windows dist/assets && shx cp src/infrastructure/database/*.sql dist/infrastructure/database/ && shx cp src/infrastructure/database/migrations/*.sql dist/infrastructure/database/migrations/ && shx cp src/windows/*.html dist/windows/ && shx cp assets/snowtree-logo.png dist/assets/
